evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative to erase knowledge functions as a coercive directive controlling what information may be retained, while the speaker supplies the specific facts to be purged.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Same imperative-to-purge pattern: a coercive command to eliminate retained information, specifying the knowledge domain to be erased.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgePurge
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority to command the erasure of specific retained knowledge, rather than merely requesting or persuading?
